description: Machine-readable source of truth for feature status. The scheduler picks the lowest-priority feature that is not 'passing'; the verifier gates the transition to 'passing'. Each feature that maps to the GitHub tracker carries `issue` (GitHub #) and `epic` (GitHub #); merging its PR closes the issue (the issue-sync Action) and the same PR flips the feature to 'passing' with evidence. See docs/harness/issue-tracking.md + docs/harness/README.md.

rules.cross_reference_github_issue: every tracker-mapped feature carries `issue` + `epic`; feature.status and the GitHub issue state must agree (passing <-> closed)

status_legend.blocked: Cannot continue until a documented blocker is resolved (see notes).
status_legend.passing: Required verification has run and evidence is recorded. Irreversible without a documented regression.

baselines.backend: go build ./... && make check  (go vet + golangci-lint + go test -race -shuffle=on ./...)
baselines.web: cd web && npm run build && npm test
baselines.end_to_end: ./deploy/smoke.sh  (stack up; assert gateway healthy, scripted kill triggers self-heal, dome closes; tear down)
